title: Information Technology Network (ITN) Manager
raw_text:
Job Title                                                                                                                     Job Code
Information Technology Network (ITN) Manager                                                                                  002838
Job Family                                 NOC                Short Title (30 Characters)                     Short Title (14 Characters)
Management                                 TBD                IT NETWORK MANAGER                              IT NET MANAGER
Pay Plan             Career Field          Other Relationships and Rules
Enlisted             ITN                   NEC TXXX series and other NECs as assigned
Job Description
Information Technology Network (ITN) Managers are responsible for overseeing network operations and ensuring the quality of maintenance through
effective monitoring; plan, coordinate, and manage unit-level Information Systems (IS) security and integration across platforms, fleets, and services;
approve policies for and direct Information Assurance (IA) programs; manage and implement IS security countermeasures and network security programs;
develop and review IS security assessment and authorization packages; plan and prepare for network expansions and upgrades and overall operations;
oversee production processes to ensure efficiency; manage administrative functions and security procedures governing the special security program; serve
as unit Information Systems Security Manager (ISSM) or unit Systems Administrator (SYSADMIN); ensure quality control through risk analyses and
standard implementation; engage with Commanding Officers and key personnel to address operational issues and challenges; manage operational
performance and evaluate team performance; and develop training plans to define long-term goals and objectives.

nlx_method: NLx employer-demand profiles; private-only ownership unverified. Six-digit profiles pool specialty weighted task incidences after the existing review exclusion mask and five-job task-support floor; destination SOCs require 200 postings and nonzero tasks. Military profiles use binary accepted task presence and the same NLx reference RCA weights as civilian profiles: reciprocal positive task shares (zero weight for reference-absent tasks) of pooled retained support-five NLx weighted incidences across 1,016 reference specialties (912 eligible comparison candidates), sqrt(q * rca_weight), then L2 normalization and cosine. No military crosswalk codes enter the task ranking. All positive top-20 results retained; zero-similarity destinations are not recommendations. Shared field/rating duties are included; general Naval Standards remain separate by paygrade. Summary compares non-future individual source entries (versions can repeat) with nonempty reference sets; grouped, future and general-standard entries remain in all outputs. Hit@k is the fraction with at least one reference SOC recovered; ties are averaged exactly. References outside NLx remain in denominators. DMDC reference status is from July 2024, not current 2026 status.
